Hero.description: Specializing in scalable web architecture, design systems, and high-performance interfaces. With 5+ years of professional experience building robust applications using Next.js, TypeScript, and GraphQL. Creator of Bastet UI — showcasing advanced multi-theme architecture and modern component design
Hero.card1Desc: Advanced design systems, multi-theme architecture, and reusable components.
Hero.projectsDesc: A glimpse of my latest work built with modern technologies.

achievements: Design and implementation of a comprehensive multi-tenant platform (composed of two applications) for various sports federations in Mexico, using Next.js 14 (App Router) and a modular architecture.
Developed the public affiliation application, implementing dynamic domain detection (Edge/Middleware) to load custom configurations (logos, color palettes, and branding) specific to each federation.
Built an advanced administrative panel for comprehensive affiliate management, landing page content configuration, coupon creation module, and statistical dashboards.

Technical leadership in the creation of a visual affiliate credentials editor (WYSIWYG with drag-and-drop functionality using react-grid-layout), enabling multi-sided customization and template synchronization.
Efficient management of server state and complex data flows using TanStack React Query, hybridizing REST APIs and GraphQL integrations.
Developed the company's proprietary telecommunications project management application (a hybrid solution combining Notion and Jira features).
Led the creation and standardization of a reusable component system using Atomic Design methodology (Atoms and Molecules) for the entire team.
Responsible for reviewing Pull Requests (PRs), ensuring code quality and proposing continuous improvements to the development team.
Implemented global state management using Jotai and native React Contexts/Providers.
End-to-end development of a PQR (Petitions, Complaints, Claims, and Suggestions) management system focused on customer service.
Implemented advanced code integrations with conversational intelligence platforms such as Dialogflow and LivePerson.
Generated dynamic reports and charts based on PQR data management.
Developed complementary backend features using Node.js, Google Cloud Functions, and database management with Firebase and MongoDB.
